title: Slow Horizon
description: A progressive house and trance track in A minor at 126 BPM, 224 bars (about 7:07). Layers arrive slowly: kick and pad, then an offbeat bass, chord stabs, a pluck arpeggio, a lead hook, a break with strings and a clap roll, and two peaks before a long fade. Filter lines and slow modulators move over 16 to 32 bars. Measured, not listened to.
